mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the visual pathways was most worthwhile: the contrast between incoming light and outgoing nerve signals clarified what the eye sends to the brain.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the three front parts was straightforward but a little repetitive; the explanation after the final fitting made their different roles clearer.

surprise.text: I expected to add the eye-moving muscles before connecting the eyes to the body. The compatibility feedback revealed the required order and made the connection automatically.

arbitrary.text: The required order for attaching the muscles felt somewhat arbitrary because the visible descriptions did not make that dependency clear beforehand.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it similarly connected a familiar experience to how body structures work, though repeated obvious fittings could become tedious.
